verdict.rationale: Requesty exposes a documented, OpenAI-compatible public API (base_url swap, quickstart docs) plus a rich set of documented API-level features (fallback policies, load balancing, caching, structured outputs, BYOK) that let an AI-native user drive the product programmatically. missing for 10: an actual OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found all candidate spec paths 404) and independent third-party corroboration of API robustness.
